The journey ZevroCRM covers

Nine stages. One record.

Everything from the enquiry to the handover, including the money. Deliberately nothing behind the site gate — no procurement, BOQ or accounting.

01

Enquiry

99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, IndiaMART, JustDial and Facebook or Instagram lead forms land on their own, next to the website form and chatbot — deduplicated by phone, in one inbox.

99acresMagicBricksHousing.comIndiaMARTJustDialFacebookInstagramWebsite formChatbotWhatsAppWalk-inReferral
02

Assign

Auto-assignment by project, location or budget the moment the enquiry arrives. Duplicates merge; every lead has one owner.

03

Follow-up

Click-to-call with the call logged against the lead, WhatsApp, notes and tasks, with each stage change attributed. A score 0–100 with a written reason and a next best action.

04

Site visit

Book visits, assign executives, send reminders, and record what happened after every tour.

05

Quote

Cost-sheet builder — area, rate, car park, corpus, GST — totalled live, and a branded PDF with bank, UPI and a scannable QR. Revisions supersede, never overwrite.

06

Booking

The unit is held, then booked. Milestones are seeded from your template; the customer gets their own portal and can pay a milestone online through a payment link.

07

Construction & payments

Stages with photographs drive the payment demands. Receipts, GST and TDS on every payment; a statement of account per booking.

08

Handover

A relationship manager owns the customer after sales: documents to collect, dues to chase, a handover checklist.

09

Support

Tickets raised from the portal, routed to staff by rule, with the whole history on record.

After the booking

A generic CRM stops
at “deal won”.

Booking, milestones, receipts, GST and TDS, the statement of account and the handover — the money is part of the record.

Milestones from a template

Each booking carries a payment schedule seeded from the workspace’s own template. Overdue detection sends 3-day and 1-day reminders.

Receipts and the statement

Every payment gets a numbered receipt. Paid, due and balance per booking, with GST and s.194-IA TDS on each line.

The customer’s own portal

Buyers see dues, bank and UPI details, receipts, documents and the same construction timeline your staff see.

Questions we hear often

Everything a property
team asks us first.

Straight answers on what ZevroCRM does, who it is for, and how your data is handled.

ZevroCRM is a real estate CRM for builders, developers and property sales teams in India. It keeps every property enquiry, site visit, follow-up, negotiation and booking in one pipeline, so a sales manager can see which deals are moving and which have gone quiet without asking anyone for a status update.

ZevroCRM is built for residential developers, builders, in-house property sales teams and the channel partners who sell for them. It suits teams running one project or several, from a five-person sales desk to a multi-project sales organisation.

A generic CRM stops at “deal won”. ZevroCRM continues through what happens next in property sales: unit inventory with holds, the cost sheet and branded quote, the booking, payment milestones with numbered receipts and GST/TDS, construction stages that date the payment demands, a customer portal, channel-partner commissions released as money is collected, and the handover.

ZevroCRM is priced flat per workspace per month, not per user. Starter is ₹4,999 (10 staff seats), Growth is ₹12,999 (30 seats, adds AI scoring, automation journeys, the unit grid and channel partners), and Enterprise is ₹24,999 (unlimited staff, your own domain and WhatsApp/SMS senders). Prices are exclusive of GST, as of September 2026.

Each booking carries a payment schedule seeded from your workspace template. Every payment gets a numbered receipt with GST and s.194-IA TDS recorded, and the statement of account shows paid, due and balance. Construction stages set the due date of the linked demand as “date reached plus grace days”, so a demand is raised against evidence rather than a spreadsheet date. Money already paid is never re-dated.

Book a demo and we run a 30-minute walkthrough set up with your own projects, with guidance on moving off spreadsheets. Write to hello@zevrocrm.com or use the form on this page; we reply within one business day.
